messages.subject: Obs entered as Clusters
parts:
I am trying to analyze point transect data from a multi-bird species stud=
y and have a lot of questions but I'll start with a basic one. The data =
was entered into the database as clusters in distance bins (0-10m,25m,50m=
,100m,150m,200m). However, the observations were not necessarily in clus=
ters and may have been individuals in different locations. Is it preferr=
ed that I change my data structure to individuals or is it ok that I leav=
e them entered as cluster? If I must change my data structure does anybo=
dy have an effecient method to do so either in Excel, SAS or Distance?

Thank you,
Tyler Beck
Florida Atlantic University
